verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AI features that generate content: incident summaries, AI-drafted retrospectives, Copilot suggestions and meeting transcription. It also shows structured Slack slash commands (`/fh`, `/fh update`). None of this documents operating FireHydrant by issuing natural-language commands. The official MCP server is a building block that lets an external AI client drive the API, which belongs to a separate story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
